## Purpose

Describe the user-visible problem and the outcome of this change.

## Maintainer coordination

- [ ] A maintainer invited or approved this code contribution before implementation.
- [ ] The applicable contribution/licensing terms were confirmed before work began.

Unsolicited code contributions cannot currently be accepted. See `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] Relevant Swift packages build when Swift code changes.
- [ ] No private source, credentials, customer licences, signing keys, or generated app artifacts are included.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries are updated where needed.

## Evidence

List the commands run and summarize their results. Add sanitized screenshots only
when they materially help review the change.
